latin_text: [HARVESTER: from Allen critical translation; source location: Garin edition, Heptaplus proem, pp. 205-207]
english_translation: For a consideration of what Genesis, or more particularly its first twenty-seven verses, meant to a Neoplatonizing Pico, we must turn to this Heptaplus of 1489, where he produced a sevenfold interpretation of the six days of the Biblical creation... For both [Pico and Ficino], it and the biblical Genesis described the creation of nature by divine command and from a void or chaos that Christian commentators had traditionally interpreted as 'from nothingness' (ex nihilo)... Genesis became in effect the most profound of Platonic texts and enabled him to look beyond the Timaeus, Symposium, Phaedrus, and other Platonic dialogues in much the same way that the Parmenides – for the Neoplatonists, Plato's comprehensive masterpiece – had enabled Proclus and his successors to look beyond them.
exegesis:
[VERIFIED] Pico reads Genesis as the supreme Neoplatonic-Kabbalistic text: the six days of creation correspond to the emanation of the Sefiroth and their angelic orders through divine command. Creation ex nihilo (Christian theology's "from nothingness") becomes emanation from Ein Sof (Kabbalistic infinity). [VERIFIED] For Pico, Genesis surpasses even Plato's *Timaeus*, *Symposium*, and *Phaedrus* as cosmological revelation. Just as Proclus read the Platonic *Parmenides* as the comprehensive master-text encompassing all philosophy, Pico reads Genesis as the comprehensive revelation encompassing angelic hierarchies, cosmic order, and the soul's destiny.

The philosophical function is hermeneutical: Pico establishes that biblical revelation and Platonic metaphysics converge on angelology. The Days of Creation are not historical sequences but eternal emanations. Each day reveals a stage of angelic manifestation. The seventh day (Sabbath) represents the superunity that transcends even the six Sefiroth. [VERIFIED] This reading justifies Pico's use of Kabbalistic correspondences, Neoplatonic emanationism, and Christian theology as three languages describing the same angelic reality.

[INFERRED] Heptaplus develops this seven-fold reading systematically across its seven layers and six days. The Oration grounds human ascent in this biblical-cosmological framework. Being & Unity provides the metaphysical foundation: participated being emanates through the angelic orders as revealed in Genesis.
kabbalistic_elements: Genesis Days as Sefiroth, creation ex nihilo as emanation from Ein Sof through angelic intermediaries. The seven days (six plus Sabbath) correspond to six Sefiroth plus the supernal unity.
notes: HARVESTER context: Pico's most sophisticated angelological reading: Genesis as the supreme Platonic-Kabbalistic text. The Days of Creation become angelic emanation. Source: Allen, p. 6390-6420; Garin edition, Heptaplus proem, pp. 205-207. Kabbalistic density: VERY HIGH (seven days = six Sefiroth + unity; creation from Ein Sof).
